rebirth.help:
Rebirth partner to the specified ranks

Start in the cathedral and the bot will move you to the correct location. With --mitama, a mitama fusion will be performed and --mitama-ranks becomes required. After any stop, the same command will continue where you left off

--check will validate your run without running

ranks.help: One digit for every path, or 12 digits, one per path in order (Tiwaz to Wyrd)

mitama.help: The mitama to fuse partner with between the two ranks: 1 Ara, 2 Nigi, 3 Kusi, 4 Saki

mitama_ranks.help: The ranks after the mitama fusion, as --ranks

end_path.help: The path partner ends on, 1 to 12

check.help: Show what the run would do, what it costs, and what would stop it

tmg.help:
Farm hazel branches without wanting to mudo yourself

Start in the TMG lobby and the bot will move and interact as necessary, leaving only the Lucifuge fight to be done manually

The bot automatically loots from the box: Magnetite, MAG Presser α, Hazel Branches, Hazel Wand, DCM: Lucifuge, DS: Lucifuge

cycles.help: How many cycles to do; infinite otherwise

false.help: Go straight to the roof, keeping the ghosts (two MAG Presser α per cycle)

demon_force.help:
Roll demon force items on partner

Normally, the bot will wait for you to accept or discard a roll before continuing. Including any of the aliases below will put the bot in whitelist mode and discard any roll or category of roll not included in the set of aliases passed

Match any other effect by its name, using hyphens for spaces, and the lowest value kept (0 for any), e.g. --spread-resist 30

Item priority: green sands > red sands > blue sands > scabbards > loops

rolls.help: How many rolls to make; without it, until the items run out

mitama_socket.help:
Allocate mitama on partner according to the specified plan

Start in the cathedral and the bot will move you to the correct location. The bot adds only what partner lacks from the plan and never removes. For the plan, you may input a string matching the specified format, or a share link from https://new-moon-database.streamlit.app/mitama

--check will validate your run without running

plan.help: 12 words, one per path in order, a letter and a count for each type the path holds (A Ara, N Nigi, K Kusi, S Saki), - for none; alternatively, the share link

check.help: Show what the run would allocate, what it costs, and what would stop it

mitama_reroll.help:
Allocate and remove mitama until the specified path reaches a stat target

Start in the cathedral and the bot will move you to the correct location. Allocates mitama according to the specified mix, repeating until either the total stat bonus for that path reaches the target, or the target is determined to be out of reach. If out of reach, it removes the mitama and tries again

mix.help: The mitama to fill it with, as a plan word (e.g. K4S4); without it, what the path holds

attempts.help: How many attempts; without it, until the mitama or the macca run out

check.help: Show what the run would do, what it costs, its odds, and what would stop it
